description: Add a pure, testable Core slide-op helper plus unit tests. SlideOperations is a static class over List<PresentationSlide> that keeps Order dense/0-based: add appends with next Order; delete removes + renumbers; MoveUp/MoveDown swap Order (no-op at ends); Normalize sorts by Order then redensifies. Add xUnit tests for the helper and extend SlidePresentationServiceTests with an UpdateAsync round-trip built from the helper. This is a self-contained Core/Tests feature with NO UI dependency; FEAT-002 (the WPF editor) depends on it.
steps: Create c:\Users\Quang\Documents\OneWorshipcenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\.worktrees\slides-stage2\WorshipPlayer.Core\Services\SlideOperations.cs as a public static class in namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Services, using WorshipPlayer.Core.Models.

Implement, all mutating the passed List<PresentationSlide> in place and keeping Order == index (dense, 0-based): PresentationSlide AddSlide(List<PresentationSlide> slides) -> append new PresentationSlide { Order = slides.Count, Text = "" } and return it; void DeleteSlide(List<PresentationSlide> slides, int index) -> if index in range remove at index then renumber Order=position, else no-op; void MoveUp(List<PresentationSlide> slides, int index) -> if 1<=index<count swap slides[index] with slides[index-1] then renumber, else no-op; void MoveDown(List<PresentationSlide> slides, int index) -> if 0<=index<count-1 swap with index+1 then renumber, else no-op; void Normalize(List<PresentationSlide> slides) -> stable-sort by current Order then renumber 0..n-1. Do NOT read or write BackgroundImage/BackgroundColor (leave them untouched/null).

Create c:\Users\Quang\Documents\OneWorshipcenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\.worktrees\slides-stage2\WorshipPlayer.Tests\SlideOperationsTests.cs (xUnit, namespace WorshipPlayer.Tests) covering: AddSlide appends with Order == previous count; DeleteSlide at middle removes it and leaves Order 0..n-1 dense; DeleteSlide out-of-range is a no-op; MoveUp/MoveDown swap Order of neighbors; MoveUp at index 0 and MoveDown at last index are no-ops; Normalize re-sorts shuffled Order values and redensifies to 0..n-1.

Extend c:\Users\Quang\Documents\OneWorshipcenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\.worktrees\slides-stage2\WorshipPlayer.Tests\SlidePresentationServiceTests.cs with a new [Fact]: CreateAsync a presentation, build its slides via SlideOperations (add several, edit text, move one), UpdateAsync, then GetByIdAsync and assert slide count, each slide's Text, and the Order sequence 0..n-1 all round-trip; also assert GetAllAsync reflects the updated SlideCount. Reuse the existing temp-app.db ctor field and the SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() teardown already in that class.
